name: poly_door
description: Teaching plugin for the POLYMORPHIC DOOR pattern: ONE xi.pack@1 door dispatches different behaviors on the pack's producer-domain 'type' entry (bare key, NOT $type — the $ namespace is framework-reserved). type=measure returns stats over the image; type=annotate returns a derived overlay entry; an unknown type answers a sealed $fault (unsupported_type) naming the supported set in 'types' — the producer-domain mirror of the capability plane's $v/$versions idiom.
